meta.name: domain-financial
meta.description: Financial reporting rules: grain consistency, balance sheets, double-entry ledgers, fiscal year boundaries, period-over-period calculations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保财务报告符合会计准则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要生成或校验符合规范的财务报表
copy.tagline_en: Ensure financial reports comply with accounting standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate or validate compliant financial statements

howto.what: Claude 将按照会计规则处理财务报告：从事实表聚合数据，确保报告粒度一致，正确拆分资产负债表中的留存收益和当年收益，在分类账中同时显示借贷双方，计算环比时首次返回 NULL。
howto.when: 当用户询问财务报告、资产负债表、分类账或期间对比时触发，要求使用交易事实表驱动或指定粒度。

say.text: 帮我汇总上月收入表，从交易事实表驱动。
say.note: 按规则从事实表聚合，不显示零交易账户。

say.text: 这份损益表的粒度一致吗？
say.note: 检查所有指标使用相同粒度 COUNT(*)。

say.text: 拆分资产负债表中的留存收益和当年收益。
say.note: 根据财政年度边界区分两者。

howto.what_en: Claude follows accounting rules for financial reporting: aggregate from fact tables, ensure grain consistency, split retained earnings and current-year earnings on the balance sheet, preserve both sides of double entries, and return NULL for period-over-period on first build.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about financial reports, balance sheets, ledgers, or period-over-period calculations, requiring fact-table-driven aggregation or specified grain.

say_en.text: Summarize last month's revenue, driven from the transaction fact table.
say_en.note: Aggregates from fact table, omits zero-transaction accounts.

say_en.text: Is the grain consistent in this P&L report?
say_en.note: Checks all metrics use COUNT(*) at same grain.

say_en.text: Split retained earnings and current-year earnings on the balance sheet.
say_en.note: Distinguishes based on fiscal year boundary.
